component.name: Zoom Linux Native
component.summary: Unofficial Zoom client for Linux, optimized for Wayland screen sharing

description.p: Zoom Linux Native is an unofficial Electron wrapper around the Zoom Web Client, built as a resilience layer for the post-X11 era on Linux. The official Zoom desktop client (Qt) has a long-standing, unresolved crash when sharing screens on Wayland + PipeWire sessions. This project bypasses that bug entirely by using Chromium's proven WebRTC + PipeWire pipeline for screen capture.

Key features include a system tray icon, native notifications, persistent window state, automatic deep-link handling for zoommtg:// URLs, offline fallback pages, enforced Content Security Policy, and active mitigation of known Zoom Web Client UX regressions (chat panel collapse, screen share viewing glitches).
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Zoom Video Communications, Inc.
Initial stable release with full Wayland screen sharing support, system tray integration, deep link handling, offline fallback, CSP enforcement, and unit test coverage for all security modules.
